bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'GACE_REBOOT_DIAGNOSTIC_READONLY\n'
printf 'UPTIME='; uptime -p || true
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id || true
printf 'DOCKER='; systemctl is-active docker || true
printf 'USERBOT='; systemctl is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true
printf 'SERVICES\n'; systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running --no-legend --no-pager | grep -Ei 'gace|servercore|cloudflared|docker|userbot' || true
printf 'CONTAINERS\n'; docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}' || true
printf 'DISK\n'; df -h / /mnt/g 2>/dev/null || true
